newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo precious metals mostly weaker, palladium up.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo precious metals mostly weaker, palladium up.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo precious metals futures ended mostly weaker in lacklustre trade on Thursday, pressured by the yen's firmer tone against the dollar, traders said, while palladium bucked the trend to end firmer.
The newly listed TOCOM benchmark December 1997 gold contract settled at 1,335 yen per gram, unchanged from the opening. The other months were four yen lower to one firmer.

Newly listed TOCOM December platinum ended at 1,349 yen per gram, down from its opening at 1,353. Platinum was weighed down by profit taking after Wednesday's strong gains, traders said, while small-lot two-way trade was seen in gold futures.
